description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Trapjaw Kelpie.
When Trapjaw Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Trapjaw Kelpie.
When Trapjaw Kelpie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
